description: Keep all your kitchenware, small appliances and other cookware handy with Seville Classics' Single Basket Kitchen Cabinet Organizer. This system is constructed from industrial-strength steel and features UltraZinc

plating, which provides the same corrosion resistance and a similar shine to chrome plating. Each basket can hold up to 20 lbs. while the top-shelf holds up to 40 lbs. Both shelf and basket are also adjustable vertically at 1-inch intervals. Includes adjustable leveling feet for support and balance.
